title: Decision memo with pre-mortem and dissent capture
description: Produces a decision memo with alternatives, failure scenarios, and documented dissent.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: decision-memo-premortem-dissent
  title: Decision memo with pre-mortem and dissent capture
  description: Produces a decision memo with alternatives, failure scenarios, and documented dissent.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Support an accountable decision with explicit risks and minority viewpoints.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - decision-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Decision context
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - decision
          - options
          - evidence
          - stakeholders
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: analysis
      kind: agent
      name: Analyze options
      role: Decision analyst
      prompt: Compare options, trade-offs, expected outcomes, assumptions, and evidence gaps.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: premortem
      kind: agent
      name: Conduct pre-mortem
      role: Risk facilitator
      prompt: Assume the selected path failed. Identify likely failure modes, early warning signals, owners, and mitigations.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: dissent
      kind: agent
      name: Capture dissent
      role: Independent challenger
      prompt: State the strongest credible objections, conditions for disagreement, and evidence that would change the
        recommendation.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: memo
      name: Assemble decision memo
      kind: aggregator
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: decision-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Decision owner approves memo
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved decision memo
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: analysis
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: premortem
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: dissent
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: analysis
      to: memo
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: premortem
      to: memo
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: dissent
      to: memo
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: memo
      to: decision-owner
      kind: dependency
    - id: e8
      from: decision-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
